map.实际推力应大于负载，建议留 1.5~2 倍余量。水平推送还需计入导轨摩擦与启停惯: The actual thrust should exceed the load, and a margin of 1.5-2 times is advised. Horizontal pushing must also allow for rail friction and start-stop inertia; when the load approaches the thrust limit, consider a larger bore or higher pressure.

map.推进侧面积 A推 = π·D² ÷ 4；拉回侧环形面积 A拉 = π·(D² −: Piston-side area A_push = pi*D^2/4; rod-side annular area A_rod = pi*(D^2 - d^2)/4; theoretical thrust F = A*P; actual thrust = F*eta; exhaust flow Q ≈ 2.0*port^2*P_bar (L/min); piston speed v = Q x 10^6 / (A_exhaust x 60) (mm/s); cycle time t = stroke/v_push + stroke/v_rod + 0.1
map.气缸推力/速度计算 使用指南: How to use the cylinder thrust/speed calculator
map.气缸推力由受压面积乘供气压力得到，推进用全缸面积、拉回用扣除活塞杆后的环形面积，: Cylinder thrust comes from the pressurised area times the supply pressure: use the full bore area for extension and the annular area left after deducting the piston rod for retraction, then multiply by the mechanical efficiency (of the order of 0.8 by default) to get the actual thrust. Speed is controlled by throttling at the exhaust port: the exhaust flow is estimated with the empirical formula Q≈2*d^2*P(bar), and dividing by the exhaust-side area gives the piston speed. Cycle time is the extension stroke time plus the retraction stroke time plus about 0.1 s for reversal. Cushioning capacity is checked by comparing the kinetic energy 1/2*m*v^2 with the energy absorbed by the cushion chamber.
map.气缸选型：由负载与供气压力验证推力是否足够，再按目标节拍校核速度与循环时间。: Cylinder selection: verify from the load and supply pressure whether the thrust is sufficient, then check the speed and cycle time against the target cycle.
map.气缸速度由排气侧节流控制：排气口径越小、背压越高，活塞运动越慢；口径全开时速度可: Cylinder speed is controlled by throttling on the exhaust side: the smaller the exhaust port the higher the back pressure and the slower the piston; with the port fully open the speed can reach metres per second. In practice an exhaust throttle valve is used to regulate pressure and speed.
map.液压缸推力速度行程计算: Hydraulic cylinder thrust, speed and stroke calculation
map.由缸径、行程、供气压力、负载、排气口口径与活塞杆直径，计算气缸推进/拉回推力、活: From the bore, stroke, supply pressure, load, exhaust port diameter and piston rod diameter, compute the extension and retraction thrust, the piston speed and the cycle time, and check the cushioning capacity.
map.缓冲不够有什么风险？: What are the risks if the cushioning is insufficient?
map.缓冲校核：由负载动能与缓冲腔吸收能力判断缓冲是否够用，避免末端撞击端盖。: Cushioning check: judge from the load kinetic energy and the cushion absorption capacity whether the cushioning is enough, avoiding the rod end striking the end cap.
map.缓冲腔吸收能量小于负载动能时，活塞末端会撞击端盖，产生噪声、振动并加速密封与缸体: When the energy absorbed by the cushion chamber is less than the load kinetic energy, the piston end strikes the end cap, producing noise and vibration and accelerating wear on the seals and cylinder body. Increase the cushion stroke or fit a hydraulic cushion.
map.：缸径 63 mm、杆径 20 mm、供气压力 0.5 MPa、负载 50 kg: : bore 63 mm, rod 20 mm, supply pressure 0.5 MPa, load 50 kg, exhaust port 6 mm, stroke 200 mm, mechanical efficiency 0.8, cushion 20 mm: extension thrust ≈ 127 kgf and retraction thrust ≈ 114 kgf, both above the 50 kg load; average piston speed ≈ 2033 mm/s and cycle time ≈ 0.30 s. Cushioning is checked by comparing the kinetic energy 1/2*m*v^2 with the energy absorbed by the cushion chamber.
